newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo says has Point Pedernales, Ca. find.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo says has Point Pedernales, Ca. find.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Company said Thursday that an exploratory well in its Point Pedernales Field offshore California tested positive and may establish a significant extension of the reserves as reported in the company's annual results.

The A-28 well encountered 1,157 feet of net pay in the Monterey formation at a depth of 5,214 feet, and tested at a rate of 1,173 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and 69 thousand cubic feet per day (mcfd) of natural gas, the company said in a statement.
Nuevo is the operator and owns an 80 percent working interest in the well.

"We are very pleased with the implications for future development that could be set up by this successful test," commented Mike Watford, Nuevo's President and CEO. "The results confirm our interpretation of the seismic data that the field is materially larger than what is shown in our year-end reserves."
In an unrelated matter, Nuevo also announced that its Gibson 1 well, a wildcat exploration prospect in Trinity County, Texas, was abandoned after hitting rock.

Nuevo Energy Company is a Houston, Texas-based company primarily engaged in the exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas, with principal properties onshore and offshore California, in East Texas and the onshore Gulf Coast region. Internationally, offshore the Republics of Congo and Ghana in West Africa.
